{{Top}}
'''Salads''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]].<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served various types of salads including [[interstellar garden salad]], [[Herd ship's bounty salad]], [[goatgrass salad]], [[Xizor salad]], [[gartro egg salad]], [[old-fashioned protato salad]], [[acid-beet salad]], and [[nuna salad]].<ref name="Menu" />
